description: Broadband connectivity plans is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Building Digital UK. This data provides BDUK’s current view of current connectivity, future commercial plans, and BDUK interventions. These data are derived from the May 2025 update. The data has been subset to the Local Enterprise Partnership region and aggregated to postcode level to avoid identifying specific premises. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Economy and Business. Its keywords are broadband, connectivity, digital, fibre, gigabit. The portal shows 31,229 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
